findings.issue: Length check uses >=, so a trimmed query of exactly 100 characters is rejected; spec allows 100.
findings.evidence: book.ts:29 `if (trimmed.length >= SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH)` throws for a 100-character query
findings.refuter_reason: book.ts:29 uses >= against SEARCH_MAX_LENGTH (100); AC4 allows exactly 100.

findings.issue: Author clause interpolates the raw trimmed query into SQL (injection; % and _ act as wildcards; a quote gives 500).
findings.evidence: book.ts:34 `OR author LIKE '%${trimmed}%'` while only [pattern] is bound; no ESCAPE for author.
findings.refuter_reason: book.ts:34 interpolates ${trimmed} into the author LIKE clause and binds only [pattern]; breaks AC5.

findings.issue: /api/books/search is registered after /books/:id, so the alias returns 404 'Book not found'.
findings.refuter_reason: /books/:id at line 28 matches before /books/search at line 39.

findings.issue: HTMX surface: empty or missing q returns [] ('No books found.') instead of all books.
findings.refuter_reason: Empty or missing q returns no books; AC2 requires all books.

findings.issue: Author rendered unescaped with <%- %>; stored XSS.
findings.refuter_reason: Line 10 renders <%- book.author %> unescaped; spec requires <%= %>.

findings.issue: Empty-query test checks only count 50; no order check, missing q, whitespace-only q, or HTMX empty query.
findings.refuter_reason: No HTMX empty-query test, so the C4 bug goes undetected; missing and whitespace-only q untested.

findings.issue: Required model test file does not exist; model-level AC1-AC5 untested.
findings.evidence: tests/ has only db.test.ts, models/book.test.ts, routes/api.test.ts, routes/search.test.ts. SPEC.md lines 74-76 require it.

findings.issue: No test at exactly 100 or 101 characters; the >= bug would pass.
findings.refuter_reason: Nothing exercises 100 or 101, so the C1 bug passes the suite.

findings.issue: No test for % or _ as literals or SQL injection.
findings.evidence: No test sends q=%25, q=_ or q='.
findings.refuter_reason: No literal-matching coverage; C2 bug is untested.

findings.issue: Nothing covers the /api/books/search alias or the duplicate ?q=a&q=b 400 case.
findings.refuter_reason: SPEC requires checking the alias is not caught by /:id; C3 bug is untested.

findings.issue: HTMX tests are thin: no escaping check, no 'No books found.' check, no 400 fragment, no duplicate-q case.
findings.evidence: One HTMX test asserts status 200 and 'Dune'. SPEC.md lines 77-79 require an escaping check.
findings.refuter_reason: SPEC requires an escaping check on the HTMX fragment; C5 XSS is untested.
